import numpy as np
mask = (x >= 450) & (x <= 800)
y2_masked = y2[mask]
x_masked = x[mask]
if len(y2_masked) > 0:
    idx_max = np.argmax(y2_masked)
    x_peak = x_masked[idx_max]
    y1_peak = np.interp(x_peak, x, y1)
    # Tangent slope at peak from local gradient of TG curve
    i_global = np.argmin(np.abs(x - x_peak))
    grad = np.gradient(y1, x)
    slope_at_peak = grad[i_global]
    # Baseline weight at 500 C
    base_weight = np.interp(500, x, y1)
    # Onset T: where tangent line intersects baseline
    # Line eq: y = y1_peak + slope * (x - x_peak)
    # Base eq: y = base_weight
    # Solve for x: base_weight = y1_peak + slope * (t_onset - x_peak)
    if abs(slope_at_peak) > 1e-9:
        t_onset = x_peak + (base_weight - y1_peak) / slope_at_peak
        marks.append({'type': 'vline', 'x': float(t_onset), 'text': f'Onset {t_onset:.1f} °C'})
    else:
        marks.append({'type': 'text', 'x': 300, 'y': 50, 'text': 'Could not calc onset'})
else:
    marks.append({'type': 'text', 'x': 300, 'y': 50, 'text': 'No data in 450-800 range'})
